en: Tossed by the seething waves, the little{n}boat nonetheless made the short crossing{n}to the wreck more surely{n}than expected.{page}Up close, there was not a scratch on the{n}hull. It looked brand new, like a ship{n}launched that very moment, hardly one{n}that had crossed the sea.

jp: 気味が悪いほど新しいな、この船は
en: This ship's so new it's creepy.

jp: 幽霊とかが出てきそうになくって{n}いいじゃんか。中も調べてみようぜ
en: Great, no ghosts or anything, then. Let's{n}check inside too.
